name: @repometry/language-hcl
description: HCL for the Repometry tree-sitter plugin, with its grammar

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('target/main', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.cpSync('src/main/resources', 'target/main/resources', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('../../LICENSE', 'LICENSE')"
